description: Consent chokepoint (LGPD art. 7/11): tenant/programa/beneficiario/ciclo identifiers are present (receive succeeds, business_key IS derivable), but NO consent facts are asserted (consentimento_ativo/consent_checked absent -> default False). consent_gate MUST compute consent_status=ausente and route to the no_consent terminal with ZERO FHIR gather, ZERO DMN evaluation, ZERO process start -- consent, not identity, is the gate.
